'''''The Imperial Army &mdash; A Guide to Army Training for New Recruits''''' was a guide book created to teach respective recruits to the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] what to expect in their training.

{{Imp-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Several paragraphs of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]'' are said to be excerpts from this fictional guide.
